summary: BIO-key International Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a reverse stock split approved by stockholders at a special meeting. The Board set a 1-for-10 ratio, effective April 29, 2026, reducing outstanding shares from ~10.85M to ~1.085M. No fractional shares are issued; rounding up to the nearest whole share. The split is a capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation such as a going-private or restructuring transaction. The filing is a routine corporate action to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance, not a deal, and contains no special-situation elements.
